purpose: Publish the completed owned world reconstruction once immediately before Skyrim begins each menu PostDisplay sequence, leaving subsequent Scaleform UI on the native target until Present
replacement: encodeCallSiteReplacement to a process-lifetime near relay ending in the pinned RazKolbas menuDisplayProxy; the proxy preserves RCX, EDX, R8D and R9D, invokes the owned publication boundary, then calls the original target exactly once
abi: Exact bytes from RVA 0xfa51b4 materialize R9D=0, R8D and EDX from globals, and RCX from a global address before the direct CALL. The exact e441c0 prefix consumes EDX, R8D and R9B. The continuation loads the current menu vtable and calls slot +0x30, CommonLibSSE IMenu::PostDisplay.
activation: Installed with the world-draw CALL only at SKSEPlugin_Load after exact executable hash, image size, caller, target, continuation and five-byte CALL validation. Both relays are prepared before either write; failure of the second write restores the first before startup resumes.
lifetime: Callback DLL is pinned; both near relays and forwarding state remain reachable for process lifetime. No hot unpatch.
recovery: Any processing, context or subsequent reduced MRT/depth compatibility failure suspends owned SR. The original game target is always forwarded. SafeMode or either disabled patch ID prevents both coupled hooks on the next launch.
